description: Saponis formulation engines for AI agents: soap, balm, emulsion, and candle calculators plus the oil library — the same math as the benches at saponis.app. Stateless MCP endpoint at https://saponis.app/mcp; OpenAPI spec at https://saponis.app/openapi.json.
name: saponis
notes: All calculate endpoints accept partial bodies; omitted fields fall back to the bench defaults, and the response echoes the normalized input the engine consumed.
Unknown ingredient ids never throw: soap reports them in safetyAlerts (UNKNOWN_OIL); balm and emulsion report them in unknownIds.
Label generation is a Saponis Pro feature and is intentionally not exposed here, nor via the MCP endpoint.

tools.name: soap_calculate
tools.description: Compute a cold-process soap batch with the Saponis soap engine — the same math as the /soap bench. All inputs optional; omitted fields use the bench defaults (grams, 5% superfat, all-NaOH, 33% lye concentration).

unit.description: Mass unit for oil amounts and for the returned weights. Default: g.

oils.description: Oils in the recipe. Amounts are in `unit`. Unknown ids are excluded and reported in the result's safetyAlerts as UNKNOWN_OIL entries.

oilId.description: Oil id from oils_list — e.g. coconut-76, olive, palm-rspo, castor, shea-unrefined.

amount.description: Amount of this oil, in `unit`. Default: 0.

naohRatio.description: Fraction of the alkali demand met with NaOH (1 = all NaOH, 0 = all KOH). Default: 1.

naohPurity.description: NaOH purity as a mass fraction; the engine clamps to 0.85–1 for safety. Default: 1.

kohPurity.description: KOH purity as a mass fraction; the engine clamps to 0.80–1 for safety. Default: 0.9.

liquidConfig.description: How the liquid (water) amount is derived.

mode.description: concentration = lye solution strength %, ratio = water:lye ratio, water_percent_oils = water as % of oil weight. Default: concentration.

value.description: The number for the chosen mode. Default: 33.

fragranceGrams.description: Fragrance mass in `unit`; counts toward total batch weight. Default: 0.

recipe.description: Alternative input: a Saponis share-link recipe string (the `r` value from a /soap URL). When present and valid it takes precedence over the other fields.

tools.outputDescription: Returns { input, result }: the normalized recipe, and the batch result — total oil weight, dry lye split (NaOH/KOH/total), liquid weight, total batch weight, lye concentration %, water:lye ratio, water as % of oils, the fatty-acid profile, quality scores (hardness, cleansing, conditioning, bubbly, creamy, longevity, iodine, INS), and safety alerts.

tools.name: balm_calculate
tools.description: Compute a balm or salve formula with the Saponis balm engine — the same math as the /balms bench. Percents are normalized to 100; every mass derives from batchGrams.

batchGrams.description: Total batch size in grams. Default: 100.

coolMethod.description: How the poured balm cools. A fast cool (tempering) lowers the graininess risk of shea-heavy blends. Default: fast.

components.description: Waxes, butters, and liquid oils with their percents of the formula. Percents need not sum to 100 — the engine normalizes. Component ids: beeswax-yellow, candelilla, carnauba, soy-wax, shea-unrefined, cocoa-butter, mango-butter, sweet-almond-balm, jojoba-balm, mct-balm, olive-balm. Unknown ids are skipped and reported in unknownIds.

percent.description: Percent as entered; the engine normalizes where the bench does.

tools.outputDescription: Returns { input, result }: the normalized input, and per-component rows (normalized %, grams), the wax/butter/liquid-oil split, weighted-average melt point (°C and °F), firmness (soft/balanced/firm/very_firm), graininess risk (low/moderate/high), warnings, and unknownIds.

tools.name: emulsion_calculate
tools.description: Compute an oil-in-water emulsion (lotion/cream) with the Saponis emulsion engine — the same math as the /emulsions bench. Matches the emulsifier blend's HLB to the oil phase's required HLB and checks the preservative against its maximum.

batchGrams.description: Total batch size in grams. Default: 100.

oilPhasePercent.description: Oil phase size as % of the total formula. Default: 20.

evaporationPercent.description: Extra water added upfront to cover heat-phase evaporation, % of the water phase (engine clamps to 0–30). Default: 10.

oils.description: Oil-phase oils; percents are shares of the oil phase and are normalized within it. Oil ids: sweet-almond-hlb, jojoba-hlb, olive-hlb, shea-hlb, cocoa-hlb, sunflower-hlb, mct-hlb.

percent.description: Percent as entered; the engine normalizes where the bench does.

emulsifiers.description: Emulsifier blend; percents are of the total formula. Emulsifier ids: glyceryl-stearate-peg100, ceteareth-20, sorbitan-olivate, polysorbate-20, polysorbate-80, olivem-1000, btms-50, lecithin.

percent.description: Percent as entered; the engine normalizes where the bench does.

preservativeId.description: Preservative id or null. Preservative ids: phenoxyethanol, germaben-ii, germall-plus, liquid-germall-plus, optiphen, potassium-sorbate, sodium-benzoate. Default: null.

preservativePercent.description: Preservative as % of the total formula; the engine checks it against the preservative's maximum. Default: 0.

tools.outputDescription: Returns { input, result }: the normalized input, and phase percents (oil/emulsifier/preservative/water), required HLB vs blend HLB with gap and verdict (good/acceptable/mismatch/unknown), preservative verdict and max, per-oil and per-emulsifier rows with grams, water grams plus evaporation makeup, warnings, and unknownIds.

tools.name: candle_calculate
tools.description: Compute a candle batch with the Saponis Candle Studio engine — the same math as the /candles bench. Sizes the vessel fill from weighed water × wax specific gravity, and splits wax vs fragrance under an explicitly named load basis, printing the load both ways.

waterMassGramsPerVessel.description: Weighed water fill of one vessel, grams, to the intended fill line. Default: 240.

vesselCount.description: Number of vessels in the batch. Default: 4.

waxId.description: Wax from the specific-gravity library: soy-container-seed, coconut-soy-blend-seed, paraffin-container-seed, beeswax-candle-seed. Or pass any id with specificGravityOverride. Default: soy-container-seed.

specificGravityOverride.description: Your supplier's SG for the wax SKU; overrides the library value when > 0. Default: 0 (use library).

headspacePercent.description: Unfilled space at the top, % of the water-fill volume. Default: 10.

wastePercent.description: Extra melt allowance for kettle heel / spills, %. Applies to the melt only, not the fill. Default: 3.

foBasis.description: What foLoadPercent is a percent OF: the wax weight, or the finished (wax + fragrance) weight. The result always prints both. Default: wax.

foLoadPercent.description: Fragrance load percent, expressed in foBasis. Default: 8.

maxFoPercentOfWax.description: Optional user cap (% of wax weight); the result flags overMaxFo when exceeded. 0 = no cap. Default: 0.

ifraCapPercentOfFinished.description: Optional user IFRA cap for the fragrance oil (% of finished weight); the result flags overIfraCap when exceeded. 0 = no cap. Default: 0.

tools.outputDescription: Returns { input, result }: the normalized input, and the batch — SG used (library or custom), finished/wax/fragrance per vessel and in total, wax to melt and fragrance to weigh (waste allowance included), the load as % of wax and as % of finished weight, over-cap flags, and warnings.

tools.name: oils_list
tools.description: List the full Saponis oil library — the database behind the soap engine and the /oils pages. Use an oil's id as oilId in soap_calculate, and its slug with oil_get.
tools.outputDescription: Returns { oils: [...] } — every oil record: id, slug, name, botanical name, SAP values (sap_naoh, sap_koh), iodine, INS, fatty_acids profile, recommended_max_percentage, hardness_profile, INCI names, trace_speed_impact, aliases, workhorse flag.

tools.name: oil_get
tools.description: Fetch one oil from the Saponis library by slug (the id and listed aliases also resolve).

slug.description: Oil slug — e.g. coconut-oil-76, olive-oil, shea-butter-unrefined.

tools.outputDescription: Returns the full oil record (same fields as oils_list), or an error when no oil matches.
